question: Should Gateway close-on-timeout be enabled by default for existing post-auth WebSocket clients, or should the PR preserve the current ping-only default and make termination explicitly opt-in until upgrade proof is stronger?
rationale: The PR changes a shipped runtime default from non-closing pings to fail-closed socket termination and adds new config keys, which is a product and upgrade-compatibility decision beyond deterministic code review.

options.title: Preserve upgrade default
options.body: Keep existing ping-only behavior for omitted config, add an explicit opt-in for close-on-timeout, and require live proof plus config metadata before merge.

options.title: Accept default-on termination
options.body: Merge default-on close-on-timeout only with maintainer-approved upgrade rationale, real behavior proof, and docs that explain the failure mode and opt-out.

options.title: Pause for canonical repair
options.body: Leave #56215 as the canonical issue and close or replace this branch if the contributor cannot refresh conflicts and supply proof.

recommendation.title: Preserve upgrade default
recommendation.body: Keep existing ping-only behavior for omitted config, add an explicit opt-in for close-on-timeout, and require live proof plus config metadata before merge.
